newsitem.title: USA: Baltimore, Md., says may bid on 2008 Olympic games.
newsitem.headline: Baltimore, Md., says may bid on 2008 Olympic games.

text.p: Baltimore officials are considering whether to make an official bid for the 2008 Summer Olympic Games, Maryland Stadium Authority Chairman John Moag said Tuesday.
Moag said the odds are a little better than 50-50 that he will submit a bid for Baltimore to be the host city.
The Stadium Authority said it has raised the $100,000 application fee from private, anonymous sources.
Mayor Kurt Schmoke's signature is required on the bid, and Moag said he met with him Tuesday.
The United States Olympic Committee has already received entries from Houston, Seattle and Cincinnati, and officials expect further bids from New York, San Francisco, and Washington, D.C.
